crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin drops below the rainbow chart near $59K
crypto_headlines.summary: BTC slid back toward $59,000 and fell below the bottom band of the popular rainbow chart model; Arthur Hayes posted that he expects a $55K retest.

crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin hash rate posts first annual decline since 2021
crypto_headlines.summary: Glassnode says miners are switching machines off: hash rate is 8% below last year's level, with hash price at an all-time low.

crypto_headlines.title: Fidelity adds LINK, AAVE and UNI
crypto_headlines.summary: Fidelity added Chainlink, Aave and Uniswap to its crypto trading platform and retirement accounts.

crypto_headlines.title: French Senate rejects self-custody crypto declaration rule
crypto_headlines.summary: The Senate voted down a proposal that would have required citizens to declare self-custodied crypto holdings of €100,000 or more.

crypto_headlines.title: UniCredit launches a capital-protected Bitcoin product
crypto_headlines.summary: Italy's second-largest bank launched a Bitcoin-linked certificate for retail clients with 100% capital protection at maturity.

crypto_headlines.title: Abraxas Capital exits Hyperliquid
crypto_headlines.summary: Lookonchain reports Abraxas sold 219,081 HYPE, bought 4,230 ETH and withdrew all its funds from Hyperliquid after $552M in perp profits.

doginal_news.title: "Markets down, Doginal Dogs stay up"
doginal_news.summary: The pack ran a "Markets: Down. Doginal Dogs: stay up. Be a Doginal Dog." wave through Tuesday's red day.

doginal_news.title: Grail Suit Doginal Dog secured
doginal_news.summary: NebMeta picked up a Grail Suit Dog during the dip, and @doginaldogs reposted it.

doginal_news.title: DDMIAMI countdown hits 12 days
doginal_news.summary: The community is counting down to DDMIAMI, which kicks off Dec 7.

doginal_news.title: US stocks go 23/5 on exchanges Dec 6
doginal_news.summary: Pyth explains what changes when five US exchanges start trading stocks 23 hours a day, five days a week, starting Sunday, Dec 6.
